user: Give me reason code for transaction TX-0401 with amount 240.00 EUR.
answer:
I can't pick the right reason code for TX-0401 without knowing what went wrong. The code depends on the problem with the payment. These are the reason codes available for disputes, with their windows counted from the transaction date:

| Reason code | When it applies (window) |
|---|---|
| duplicate_charge | The same payment was charged more than once (60 days) |
| fraud_card_not_present | A card payment you did not make, made without the physical card (120 days) |
| unauthorized_debit | A debit from your account that you did not authorize (56 days) |
| goods_not_received | You paid but did not receive the goods (90 days) |
| service_not_rendered | You paid but the service was not provided (90 days) |

Which of these matches your situation? Also tell me the account the transaction was made from, or confirm the date if you know it. I'll check the transaction and its eligibility before anything is filed. Nothing has been opened or changed.

Payment dispute rules
## Reason codes and chargeback windows
Each reason code has a window in days from the transaction date. A dispute opened after the window closes is not eligible.

| Reason code | Window (days) |
|---|---|
| fraud_card_not_present | 120 |
| goods_not_received | 90 |
| duplicate_charge | 60 |
| service_not_rendered | 90 |
| unauthorized_debit | 56 |

Dispute handling process
## Review timelines
The review target is 10 business days for card reason codes and 20 business
days for transfer reason codes. Complex cases involving a foreign acquirer may
run to 45 calendar days; the customer is notified when that happens.

Dispute handling process
## Withdrawing a dispute
A customer may withdraw a dispute at any time before resolution. Withdrawal is
final; the same transaction cannot be disputed again under the same reason code.

Notifications
## Dispute updates
A dispute generates a notification on every state change. The notification
names the state, never the internal reason for a decision.
